lead.headline: After Midterm Defeat, Trump Faces Mostly Bad Options in Iran War
lead.summary: Trump is weighing his next move in the Iran war after Republicans lost Congress. Mediators are pushing for a peace deal while Trump considers resuming strikes.

tech.headline: OpenAI Targets Microsoft's GitHub With Deal for Pierre Computer
tech.summary: OpenAI is acquiring Pierre Computer, a code-storage startup, to fold into its Codex coding tools. The deal positions OpenAI against Microsoft's GitHub.

tech.headline: DuckDuckGo Pitches Itself to Schools Amid Backlash Over Google's AI Policy
tech.summary: DuckDuckGo is marketing its search engine to schools. The pitch follows criticism of Google's AI policy.

business.headline: Dow Soars 1,500 Points as Oil Tumbles After Democratic Win
business.summary: The Dow had its best day since April 2025 as the election outcome eased uncertainty. Falling oil prices also helped stocks.

business.headline: Uber Beats on Revenue, CEO Says Company Is Investing Significantly in Autonomy
business.summary: Uber reported third-quarter revenue above expectations. The CEO told CNBC the company is investing heavily to add driverless vehicles to its network.

business.headline: Shopify Shares Fall After Narrow Revenue and GMV Miss
business.summary: Shopify's third-quarter revenue and gross merchandise volume came in below estimates. The stock dropped about 9% after the report.

world.headline: Iran Says U.S. Election Results Show Americans Reject the War
world.summary: Tehran played down hopes for a deal to end the war after new U.S. strikes on the eve of the midterms. Iranian officials said the vote showed Americans oppose the conflict.

world.headline: Israel's Election Ends in Deadlock With No Clear Winner
world.summary: Netanyahu's Likud finished as the largest party but without a governing majority. Coalition talks are expected to be difficult.

opinion.headline: The South Just Delivered a Knockout Blow to Trump and the GOP
opinion.summary: Johnson argues that although the midterm beating of Trump and Republicans was national, the South delivered the decisive blow. He says Republicans tried to build a fire wall in the region, but it instead fueled a Democratic wave. He points to flipped red-state seats and historic upsets.
opinion.author: Theodore R. Johnson

opinion.headline: Democrats’ Wins Across the South Were No Fluke
opinion.summary: Henderson argues that Democratic victories across the South in the midterms signal a new kind of Southern Democrat rather than a one-off. She cites South Carolina voters sending Democrat Annie Andrews to the Senate as a stunning rebuke of President Trump.
opinion.author: Nia-Malika Henderson

sports.headline: Celtics Hold Off Bucks Without Tatum, 109-102
sports.summary: Paul George and Derrick White helped Boston survive a dramatic game in Milwaukee. The win snapped a short skid after a five-game winning streak ended in Houston.

sports.headline: Five Takeaways From the Red Sox' Offseason So Far
sports.summary: Analysis covers Gold Gloves, early trades and roster decisions as Boston begins the offseason. Rumors include a possible pursuit of Elly De La Cruz.

sports.headline: Packers at Patriots Week 9 Preview: Turnovers, Pressure and the 5-3 Test
sports.summary: New England hosts Green Bay in a game that tests the Patriots' standing. Picks and analysis focus on turnovers and pass rush.
